svg.text: Luke's Sermon on the Plain → Matthew's Sermon on the Mount
Luke 6:20–49 linked to its parallels in Matthew 5:1–7:29. Not one lands in Matthew 6.

24 of 30 Luke verses link to 28 Matthew verses (32 links); filled Matthew boxes have a parallel. Dashed line: Luke 6:20a narration ~ Matthew 5:2. Parallels follow a standard gospel synopsis (e.g. Aland).
Luke pairs 4 blessings with 4 woes in one sermon; Matthew has 8 blessings (+1 bonus, 5:11–12) here and saves his 8 woes for chapter 23 (23:13–29).
